$comment: C2 dependency allowlist (SPEC.md sections 2 and 15). Every npm package and Node built-in that ends up in server/index.mjs must be listed here with the reason it is needed. scripts/check-bundle.mjs fails the build otherwise. Adding an entry is a reviewed decision: no HTTP clients, ever.

packages.@modelcontextprotocol/server: MCP server SDK v2, stdio transport. Depends only on zod and @modelcontextprotocol/core; HTTP transports are not imported, so not bundled.
packages.@modelcontextprotocol/core: MCP protocol types and JSON-RPC handling shared by the SDK.
packages.zod: Schemas for tool inputs and outputs.
packages.unpdf: Reads the text and images of PDF documents for get_document_for_review: PDF.js (Apache-2.0, notice in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES) in unpdf's single-file build for servers (MIT). No worker, no canvas, no native module, no Node built-in imported statically. It is only ever given bytes, never a URL, and no font, character map or WebAssembly location; its fetch and XMLHttpRequest code paths for URLs are replaced by refusing stubs at build time (extension/scripts/build.mjs).
packages.zxing-wasm: Reads the barcodes of documents (PDF417 and Code 128: salary certificates, bank e-tax statements, SPEC.md section 5): ZXing-C++ (Apache-2.0) compiled to WebAssembly, in zxing-wasm's reader build (MIT); notices in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES. Its default is to download the .wasm from a CDN: Taxpresso never lets it. The binary ships as server/zxing_reader.wasm, is read from disk, checked against the SHA-256 zxing-wasm was built with, and instantiated by Taxpresso itself (instantiateWasm), so zxing-wasm builds no URL; its fetch and XMLHttpRequest paths are replaced by refusing stubs at build time (extension/scripts/build.mjs). No Node built-in imported.

builtins.node:http: The dashboard server on 127.0.0.1 (createServer only; ESLint bans http.request and http.get).
builtins.node:crypto: Per-session dashboard token and constant-time comparison; SHA-256 check of the barcode reader's .wasm before it is loaded.
builtins.node:fs/promises: Reads the vault folder and the bundled UI files.
builtins.node:os: Home folder for the default vault path.
builtins.node:url: Locates the bundled UI next to the server file.
builtins.node:process: stdio for the MCP transport (used by the SDK).
builtins.node:zlib: Compresses the PNG image of a scanned page sent to Claude, and decompresses barcode payloads (ZIP entries, ZLIB, GZIP: salary certificates and e-tax statements), with a cap on the output size.
builtins.node:module: createRequire for CommonJS dependencies (the bundle banner); in development it also locates the barcode reader's .wasm in node_modules (the shipped server is given its path instead). PDF.js also asks for it at run time for an optional canvas package that isn't shipped and is never used.
builtins.node:stream: PDF.js asks for it at run time to stream a PDF from a local file path; Taxpresso passes bytes, so that path never runs.
